I can't give you September 2026 rates. The data I have stops at August 2026, and the September figures aren't in it. Statistics Canada's September release may exist, but I can't check it here.

The latest month I have is August 2026 (employment rate, 15 years and over, seasonally adjusted):

| Province | August 2026 | Vector |
|---|---|---|
| Quebec | 60.6% | v2063762 |
| Ontario | 60.2% | v2063951 |

Quebec's rate was higher in August, by 0.4 percentage points. It was also higher in July 2026, when Quebec was at 60.8% and Ontario at 60.4%. This doesn't tell us which was higher in September.

Source: Statistics Canada, Table 14-10-0287-01 (Labour Force Survey). The copy I used was captured 2026-09-30.
